scope: Real HTTP, Redis, queue worker and Workerman protocol; no VPS data-plane connection

checks.check: HTTP handshake and real WebSocket full sync
Create member via HTTP and deliver queue delta
Update member through real worker and Redis
Credential rotation removes old identity before adding new
Disable member on all connected nodes
Direct access changes revoke nodes outside current grant
Traffic report reaches cap and revokes through quota worker
Manual usage reset restores limited member
Node disable reconnect and re-enable preserve qualification
Subscription visibility does not disable node credentials
Delete member revokes all connected nodes
Long-running WebSocket accepts rotated server token only
